# SwiftRide Project Instructions

## Project overview

SwiftRide is a responsive React ride-sharing web application created with Vite. Keep the interface component-based, use local CSS assets, and preserve responsive behavior across desktop and mobile layouts.

## Development

- Use React functional components and hooks.
- Keep reusable UI behavior in focused components.
- Prefer semantic HTML and accessible labels for interactive controls.
- Keep styling in the existing CSS files and avoid external media dependencies.
- Use the existing npm scripts for development and production validation.

## Validation

Run `npm run build` before completing changes. The project requires no additional extensions or runtime services.
